newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak National Bank to discuss repo rate.
newsitem.headline: Slovak National Bank to discuss repo rate.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Wednesday it would discuss whether or not to change its repo rate, currently 9.7 percent, after a rise in the average yield at a Finance Ministry 40-week T-bill auction.
"We still need to discuss our possible reaction to that, therefore any advanced comments would be only pure speculation at the moment," Peter Andresic, NBS chief dealer, told Reuters.
Average yield at the Finance Ministry 40-week T-bill auction hit 10.12 percent, up from 9.986 percent in the last auction of bills with similar maturity, 39-week T-bills, on November 14.
Dealers said the ministry accepted almost the entire amount of bids in order to finance incresing state budget deficit.
The budget deficit totalled 13.4 billion crowns as of September 30.
